subcategory_text: Run automated security tests (SAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, IaC scanning, container scanning) as part of the test suite for the executable code, and triage the findings.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-11, CA-7, SI-2
implementation_examples: Run SAST on every commit and full repository scan nightly
Triage findings based on severity and exploitability (CVSS, EPSS)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether automated security tests are executed against the build.
Determine whether findings are triaged and remediated in defined SLAs.
